The second is distillation, which boils the water and condenses the steam. Reverse osmosis uses less energy, so it is more common today. Distillation still makes sense where waste heat is cheap. Both methods leave a salty brine that must be handled carefully. Dumping it straight back into the sea can harm marine life nearby. Many plants dilute it first and spread it out.

context.assistant_text: 海水淡化主要有两种方法。第一种是反渗透，用高压把海水压过一层很细的膜。第二种是蒸馏，把海水加热成水蒸气，再冷却成淡水。反渗透更省电，所以现在用得更多。蒸馏更适合有大量废热的工厂。不过两种方法都要妥善处理剩下的浓盐水。浓盐水直接排回海里，会影响附近的海洋生物。所以很多工厂会先稀释，再分散排放。

The second is distillation, which boils the water and condenses the steam. Reverse osmosis uses less energy, so it is more common today. Distillation still makes sense where waste heat is cheap. Both methods leave a salty brine that must be handled carefully. Dumping it straight back into the sea can harm marine life nearby. Many plants dilute it first and spread it out.
